name: Vampire - Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only) - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a attack

results.text: Your strike is parried by a desperate flail of limbs, leaving only air where flesh should be.
The target twists away at the last instant, their panicked heartbeat mocking your hunger.
Your fangs scrape uselessly against bone, their wild thrashing denying you your due.
A surge of unnatural strength throws them from your grip, their life force still untouched.
Their flesh is cold and lifeless—already dead, offering nothing but the taste of rot.
